Master Registration Automation

Practice registration form automation on a free, interactive demo page with Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright.

Create a New Account

Fill in the form and submit to practice automating a registration flow with real-time password-strength validation.

Password must include:
At least 8 characters
At least one uppercase letter (A-Z)
At least one lowercase letter (a-z)
At least one number (0-9)
At least one special character (!@#$%^&*()_+)
